heading: Welcome, {guest_first_name}!
body_html:
Your account is active. In it you will find your bookings, payments, coupons and member perks – bookings made with this email address are linked automatically.

Your welcome coupon

{coupon_code} – {coupon_discount} off your next booking on our website, valid until {coupon_valid_until}. Enter the code in the price summary when you book; one coupon per booking.

{cta_button}

After your first completed stay you become a Silver member, after three a Gold member – with a coupon every year and earlier check-in or later check-out when the apartment is free.

We look forward to welcoming you!
{business_name}
